decision_rule.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: G4 and G5 pass but the fill evidence class is ESTIMATED, or G1/G2/G3 cannot be established
decision_rule.PROMOTE: impossible in this experiment: it needs observed live fills and a forward window
decision_rule.REJECT: G4 or G5 fails on a sample of at least 40 signals

bootstrap.unit: net PnL per signal (misses count as zero)

economics.halves: the research window split at its midpoint; both halves must be positive

futures_vip0.note: NOT EXECUTABLE BY THIS SPOT LANE: a bound, never a plan

aggressor_side.buy: trades with is_buyer_maker true (seller aggressed) at price <= limit
aggressor_side.sell: trades with is_buyer_maker false (buyer aggressed) at price >= limit

fill_model.anchor: reference_price (the bar open the taker paid), same instant as EXP-003L
fill_model.exit_rules: unchanged from EXP-003L and from the lane: stop 0.50 %, target 0.75 % off the fill price, stop_first inside a minute, exits adjudicated from the minute after the fill minute
fill_model.improvement: half_spread_bps (per symbol, from the lane's cost model) + offset_bps
fill_model.partial_fills: linear: net = fill_fraction * net_of_full_fill, fees included
fill_model.queue_model: queue ahead of us at the limit is unobservable without an L2 feed. It is a declared multiple q of our own order quantity; fill fraction is clamp((aggressor_volume_at_or_through_limit - q*order_qty)/order_qty, 0, 1) measured from placement (decision + latency) to decision + horizon
unobservable: displayed depth at the touch (no spot L2 published)
our queue position when we join
whether a trade at our price actually matched our order
cancel/replace traffic that would have moved us up the queue

gates.G1_reproduces_003l: F0_touch_full must restate EXP-003L's published maker_resting__spot_vip0_bnb__h15__o0 fill rate and net/fill to 1e-8, or this experiment is BLOCKED
gates.G2_dataset_provenance: the frozen 1-minute bars must match an independent download of the same minutes from data.binance.vision klines (open, high, low, close)
gates.G3_tape_integrity: every tape file must be monotonic in agg_trade_id and time, inside its UTC day, free of non-positive prices/quantities, and re-hash to its manifest digest
gates.G4_economics_pessimistic: F2 net per signal > 0, net per fill > 0 and the 95 % CI lower bound > 0
gates.G5_optimistic_ceiling: F0 (every touch fills fully at the improved price) must be net per fill > 0. If the most generous fill model already loses, fill realism cannot rescue it and no promotion may cite a better fill rate
gates.G6_holdout_closed: no dataset or analysis file covers 2026-08-06 → 2026-08-20
gates.G7_evidence_class: no live order was placed, so fills are ESTIMATED. Even if G4 and G5 passed, the ceiling would be INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never a paper promotion
gates.G8_no_live_trading: config/runtime.yaml still declares mode paper with live_trading_enabled false, and every ledger read reports zero live orders
gates.G9_config_unchanged: config/risk.yaml, config/runtime.yaml and config/vision.yaml still hash to the digests frozen here: the stop/target levels and the fee terms are not this experiment's to move after the fact

holdout.rule: no tape, klines or derived statistic for this window may be downloaded, stored or summarised in this experiment; the verifier fails if any file under dataset/ or analysis/ covers it

market_data_plan.book_source: NONE. data.binance.vision publishes aggTrades, trades and klines for spot: there is no historical spot L2 book. No book is synthesised, and no depth figure from another venue is presented as a spot book.
market_data_plan.depth_role: CALIBRATION ONLY. USD-M futures band depth is a different venue and a different instrument; it is used to size the queue assumption, never to declare a spot fill.
market_data_plan.selection_rule: every (symbol, UTC day) that contains at least one pre-registered signal, and inside it every trade in [decision-60 s, decision+16 min] for those signals. No filter on price, side or outcome; missed signals are impossible to hide

reproduction_target.note: published by EXP-003L; EXP-003M must restate it before it may price anything

prohibitions: modifying the signal, the risk policy, the exits or the fee schedules
presenting an estimate as an observed fill
using another venue's book as a spot book
live orders, private credentials or any move of funds
question: Does a maker fill model built on the observed spot trade tape leave the frozen 5m/mean_reversion candidate a positive net edge, or does EXP-003L's touch-to-fill assumption carry the result?

F0_touch_full.note: EXP-003L's assumption: any touch fills us fully at the limit

F1_tape_base.note: one order of queue ahead of us, 400 ms to reach the venue

F2_tape_pessimistic.note: four orders of queue, 2 s latency, 5 min horizon, 2 bp offset: the corner EXP-003L gated on

F3_tape_no_queue.note: queue ignored: what the tape alone allows. Brackets F0

sensitivity.note: queue is unobservable, so it is swept instead of asserted. Every point uses the same signals, tape, exits and fee schedule
